subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep this split across memory/plugin APIs and channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The request changes memory authority, persisted rule storage, conflict precedence, and channel reply behavior, and current main has useful pieces but no settled product contract for that layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Narrow Fixes
options.body: Use the Feishu issues and candidate PRs for message-loss subsets, and open a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that layer.

options.title: Route Through Plugin API
options.body: Require any durable rule-learning proposal to prove current memory/plugin APIs are insufficient before adding core rule surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available cross-surface history for multi-agent routing, Feishu helper boundaries, and product-level rule/channel semantics.
